content.rendered:
Download FTS Mod FIFA 2020 Apk Data Obb full for Android offline, with kits updates players transfers.

FTS Mod FIFA 20 comes with real interface just like the official FIFA mobile game, logos and buttons looks the same.

In the First Touch Soccer Mod FIFA 2020 there is unlimited coins for you to use and manage your team in manager mode, buy and transfer players from other clubs, upgrade your stadium etc.

New players have been added to match the current players available in the real world such as Christiano Ronaldo in Juventus, Mohammed Salah in Liverpool, Hazard in real Madrid etc.

You can also change the in game language of First Touch Soccer 20 Mod FIFA 2020 Apk Mod to any language of your choice if you wish to by going to the game settings.

If you want to play or switch to mode such as Easy, Hard, Medium level of game play you can do so by going to the game settings, it all depends on how skill full your are In the game.

There is new logo, new stadium, score boards, pitch grass look green and real with smooth gameplay because of the game buttons that doesn’t lag.

Game interface was ported from the original FIFA mobile, which make everything unique as if you are enjoying the same game.
